name: shelf-podcasts
description: Find the right podcast episodes, rank a shortlist, and pull the full transcripts of the ones you pick.

exa_api_key.title: Exa API key
exa_api_key.description: Finds pages by meaning. Get one at exa.ai. The helper reads EXA_API_KEY from ~/.claude/.env or your shell.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API key
firecrawl_api_key.description: Reads JavaScript-heavy pages. Get one at firecrawl.dev. The helper reads FIRECRAWL_API_KEY from ~/.claude/.env or your shell.

supadata_api_key.title: Supadata API key
supadata_api_key.description: Pulls video transcripts and YouTube search. Paid and metered. The helper reads SUPADATA_API_KEY from ~/.claude/.env or your shell.
